purpose: Maintain stable defect/known-failure identity and evidence through reproduction, triage, duplicate/supersession, ownership, fix-candidate and verification state without turning QA into product priority authority.
allowed_actions: Create a stable defect id from observed evidence.
Link duplicates without deleting their provenance.
Append state transitions with actor/executor and evidence reference.
Attach exact fix candidate and verification evidence.
forbidden_actions: Close a defect because a model predicts it is fixed.
Rewrite old reproduction evidence after behavior changes.
Assign product/business priority by QA authority.
Merge semantically distinct failures only because symptoms look similar.
deterministic_boundaries: Identifier uniqueness, state-transition logging, duplicate links and exact-version checks may be deterministic.
Semantic duplicate judgment, severity/priority and expected-behavior disputes require bounded professional/owner judgment.
failure_boundary: If expected behavior, ownership, duplicate identity or fix equivalence is ambiguous, HOLD and hand off instead of silently changing state.
